mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park. We have a beautiful First Quarter moon tonight, and keep an eye out at 10:22 PM for the space station pass, traveling from the direction of Cross Plains over toward Oregon. The overnight low will be 56 degrees with no rain expected.

The City of Verona provides several ways to keep you informed. You can subscribe to their monthly digital newsletter, visit the city blog, or watch Common Council and Plan Commission meetings live on VHAT, which is the city's government and public access cable channel available on Spectrum and TDS.

We have plenty to do today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, be sure to check out the free Concerts in the Park at Century School or head over to Hop Haus for trivia night.
Looking at the weekly activity report, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver had become stuck on a large rock. The 36-year-old driver was subsequently arrested for an O-W-I offense.
Mint Explosion is the flavor of the day today. The shop is open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat. If you happen to miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Really Reese's.
